video_title: We Bought A FAST Super SUV For £12,000!
evidence: SponsorRadar records HOLY / We Are HOLY sponsoring Autoalex v2's August 21, 2026 English-language YouTube video. Autoalex v2 has about 276K subscribers, and SponsorRadar also records another HOLY sponsorship on the channel on July 24, 2026, showing repeat recent creator spend. HOLY's official partnership page runs an active Creator Programme with entry thresholds as low as 5K average YouTube views and 5K average TikTok views, offering free products, discounts, revenue sharing, custom shakers and deeper creator partnerships. Sara Kaeppler's current LinkedIn profile lists HOLY as her employer, and her HOLY announcement identifies her role as Influencer Marketing Manager UK.
